narr: Warm, humid, and unstable conditions were in place across the Four State Region on May 9th, ahead of a cold front and attendant shortwave trough that traversed the Southern Plains during the afternoon. Large scale forcing ahead of the trough increased during the afternoon, with scattered showers and thunderstorms developing near and ahead of the front across Southwest Arkansas, North Louisiana, and East Texas. Moderate instability and adequate wind shear contributed to the development of strong to severe thunderstorms across the region, which produced damaging winds and large hail. Locally heavy rainfall also fell from these storms, which resulted in localized flash flooding in Union County. These storms exited Southwest Arkansas into North Louisiana during the late evening hours with the passage of the cold front.
ev: Portions of the Oak Manor area west of El Dorado were flooded.
A temporary bridge on Highway 82 near Strong was damaged and was in danger of washing out.
